title: CloudTech to bring institutional-grade crypto trading to APAC investors
summary: CloudTech Group, a leading blockchain financial infrastructure firm, has launched RooRooEx, a next-generation digital asset trading platform designed to give high-net-worth and individual investors access to institutional-grade trading tools, liquidity and pricing.
content: Blockchain financial infrastructure firm CloudTech Group has launched RooRooEx, a new digital asset trading platform. The platform is designed to provide high-net-worth and individual investors across the APAC region with access to institutional-grade trading tools, liquidity, and pricing, expanding professional-grade cryptocurrency trading capabilities to broader market participants.

APAC பிராந்தியத்தில் உள்ள உயர்நிகர மதிப்பு மற்றும் தனிநபர் முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு நிறுவன தரத்திலான வர்த்தக கருவிகள், பணப்புழக்கம் மற்றும் விலை நிர்ணயம் ஆகியவற்றை வழங்கும் வகையில் இந்த தளம் வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Monero sees $54M perpetual inflow: Will liquidity clusters trigger XMR’s pullback?
summary: XMR’s bullish run will depend on sustained momentum and an elevated Funding Rate.
content: Monero recently recorded a significant perpetual inflow of $54 million. Analysts are now watching to see whether liquidity clusters will trigger a pullback for XMR. The cryptocurrency's ongoing bullish run largely depends on maintaining sustained market momentum alongside an elevated Funding Rate.
